# CleanAlta Thailand

> CleanAlta SAS is a French building cleaning company (founded December 2024, Maule, France; SIRET 938 788 510 00015) that cleans façades, glass, roofs and solar panels with tethered drones (under 25 kg), water-fed poles (up to 17 m) and aerial platforms (up to 40 m). It operates in France and Switzerland and is preparing a launch in Thailand. As of October 2026 it has NOT yet operated in Thailand: it is selecting pilot sites and a local partner, and will register drones and pilots with the NBTC and CAAT before any flight.

Key facts (verified, public):
- Method: heated osmosed (purified) water at low pressure, no detergent on glass; slow-acting biocide or enzymatic treatments on roofs.
- Cleaning rate: 500–800 m² per hour depending on dirt level, method and protocol.
- Public references in France: RATP (Paris Saint-Lazare, October 2025: 400 m² of glazing in one night, no traffic interruption; RATP reports intervention time divided by five), Saint-Gobain Recherche (Aubervilliers: drone + pole, led to a two-passes-per-year contract), CHU de Toulouse Rangueil (8th-floor windows on a working hospital), CNRS ISMO Orsay ("periodic table" glass façade, drone + aerial platform). Veolia and Bouygues are also cited references.
- Press: Le Journal du Grand Paris, France 3, Ville, Rail & Transports.
- Founder: Vincent Goleau, professional drone pilot for 10+ years, also founder of TELEPILOTE SAS (drone training centre since 2014), which holds 10% of CleanAlta and acts as its UAS operator in France. CleanAlta is not a subsidiary of TELEPILOTE.
- Not offered in Thailand: drone inspection, thermography, 3D modelling.
- Contact: WhatsApp +33 6 86 50 55 71, eco@cleanalta.net. French website: https://www.cleanalta.com
